value.rationale: The independent reset clocks create a motivated, analytically distinct nonequilibrium confinement mechanism. The result predicts a full polar spatial distribution, sharp density-edge regimes, and two different experimentally relevant decay scales with noncommuting limits; fixed-lag observations miss a strictly positive fraction of equal-time fluctuations. This is more than computing a routine stationary moment or renaming existing Beta RTP laws.
